title: Türkiye in December: Winter Atmosphere, Rumi Şeb-i Arus & Year-End Travel
seoTitle: Türkiye in December: Istanbul, Şeb-i Arus & Skiing
metaDescription: Plan Türkiye in December around Istanbul winter charm, Konya Şeb-i Arus (Dec 7–17), Cappadocia balloons, ski openings, and New Year hotel demand.
quickAnswer: Turkey in December offers atmospheric winter culture without peak-season crowds. Istanbul glows with roasted chestnuts, salep cafés, and historic hammams; Konya hosts the annual Şeb-i Arus commemoration of Rumi from December 7 to 17; Cappadocia balloons fly on clear frosty mornings; and major ski and thermal resorts open by mid-month.

body.text: What makes Istanbul and Konya special in December?

December pairs Istanbul's cosy winter street life—steaming cups of cinnamon-dusted salep, hot boza in Vefa, Bosphorus ferries in crisp mist, and quiet museums—with Konya's deeply moving Şeb-i Arus ceremonies. Held every December 7–17, the commemoration honours 13th-century Sufi poet Mevlâna Celâleddîn Rûmî with nightly Mevlevi Sema rituals.

In 2026, Konya marks the 753rd anniversary of Rumi's Vuslat (reunion), with official ticket sales and ceremony updates published on the [Ministry of Culture and Tourism Şeb-i Arûs portal](https://sebiarus.ktb.gov.tr/TR-383045/information-about-ticket-sales.html). Visitors combine evening Sema ceremonies at the Mevlana Cultural Centre with daytime visits to the green-tiled Mevlana Museum and the Tomb of Shams Tabrizi—background covered in the [GoTürkiye Şeb-i Arûs guide](https://goturkiye.com/mevlanarumi/seb-i-arus) and our dedicated [Konya Şeb-i Arus December 2026 guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/konya-seb-i-arus-ceremonies-december-2026). High-speed YHT trains link Istanbul to Konya in roughly four and a half hours, making a two-city December route straightforward. In Istanbul, winter opening schedules at Ministry sites can be checked ahead on [Muze.gov.tr](https://muze.gov.tr/ETicket).
Do Cappadocia hot air balloons fly in December?

Yes—Cappadocia hot air balloons operate year-round, including throughout December, whenever morning wind speeds and visibility meet Turkish Civil Aviation Authority safety thresholds. Winter flights cancel more often than summer launches, so staying three nights gives you the strongest odds of catching a crisp, snow-dusted sunrise flight.

When skies clear after a cold front, December sunrises over Göreme and Uçhisar are extraordinary: pale winter light illuminates frosted fairy chimneys and volcanic valleys while cave hotels serve warm breakfasts beside wood fires. Daytime highs typically sit between 4°C and 8°C with sub-zero pre-dawn pickups, so thermal base layers, insulated coats, hats, and gloves are essential. Even if a morning flight is grounded, underground cities like Kaymaklı and Derinkuyu stay at a constant mild temperature year-round, and [Cappadocia's volcanic-tuff wineries](https://goturkiye.com/vineyards/cappadocia-vineyard-route) remain open for indoor tastings.
Which winter thermal and ski resorts open by mid-December?

High-altitude ski centres—especially Palandöken (Erzurum), Erciyes (Kayseri), and Uludağ (Bursa)—typically open their lifts by mid-December as snow depth builds, alongside Kartalkaya and Sarıkamış. Travellers seeking warmth over slopes pair winter sightseeing with mineral-rich thermal spa towns in Afyonkarahisar, Bursa, Pamukkale (Karahayıt), or Yalova.

According to the [GoTürkiye Skiing Guide](https://goturkiye.com/skiing) and [GoTürkiye Mountain Profiles](https://goturkiye.com/blog/6-unmissable-mountains-in-turkiye), Erciyes rises to 3,917 metres just 45 minutes from Cappadocia's Kayseri Airport, allowing an easy winter pairing of cave hotels and alpine slopes. Palandöken (3,271 m) sits minutes from Erzurum city centre with long, high-altitude runs and reliable early-season powder, while Uludağ (2,543 m) south of Bursa pairs easily with Istanbul via ferry or road and Bursa's historic Ottoman thermal baths.

How do Christmas and New Year's Eve bookings affect Istanbul hotels?

While December 25 is a regular working day in Türkiye, international Christmas holidays and Turkish New Year's Eve (Yılbaşı) celebrations create a sharp demand surge in Istanbul from December 23 through January 2. Bosphorus luxury hotels, Nişantaşı and Karaköy boutiques, and gala-dinner restaurants raise rates and sell out weeks ahead.
Use this December booking checklist to stay ahead of year-end peaks:

items: Lock NYE hotels early: Reserve December 29–January 2 stays in Istanbul at least two to three months ahead to avoid minimum-stay surcharges and inflated last-minute pricing.
Book December 31 dining ahead: Bosphorus-view restaurants and hotel gala dinners require fixed-menu pre-reservations well before mid-December.
Enjoy quiet early December: The first two weeks of December deliver Istanbul's lowest winter hotel rates and calmest historic sites.

faq.q: Is Istanbul decorated for New Year's Eve in December?
faq.a: Yes. Districts such as Nişantaşı, İstiklal Avenue, Karaköy, Bebek, and major Bosphorus hotels put up extensive winter light installations and New Year displays throughout December.

faq.q: Are shops and museums open on December 25 in Türkiye?
faq.a: Yes. December 25 is a normal business day across Türkiye, so museums, bazaars, restaurants, and intercity transport all operate on standard winter schedules. January 1 is a public holiday when some museums open later or close.

faq.q: How early do I need tickets for Konya's Şeb-i Arus ceremonies?
faq.a: Official tickets usually release in October for the December 7–17 programme, and the final night on December 17 sells out first. Monitor the Ministry's official [Şeb-i Arûs page](https://sebiarus.ktb.gov.tr/TR-383045/information-about-ticket-sales.html) early.

faq.q: Does it snow in Istanbul in December?
faq.a: Heavy snow is more typical in January and February, though light sleet or a brief snowfall can occur in late December. Expect cool, damp 7–12°C days overall.

faq.q: Can I combine Cappadocia and skiing in one December trip?
faq.a: Yes. Mount Erciyes Ski Center near Kayseri lies under an hour from Cappadocia, letting travellers stay in cave suites while skiing groomed volcano slopes.

faq.q: What is the warmest part of Türkiye in December?
faq.a: Antalya and the southern Mediterranean coast remain the mildest region in December, with daytime highs around 15–17°C and plenty of sunny breaks between winter rainstorms.
